# A parser example is not an observation

This small code example is copied from my own scratch file. It illustrates a text fixture; its strings are not an account of museum activity.

```python
status = "codeonlynightjar codeonlynightjar codeonlynightjar"
print(status)
```

An inline example, `codeonlynightjar`, should remain an example. [[Field methods]] needs to keep demonstrations separate from observations.
